bio: Greggory D. Hull is an American politician and businessman who served as mayor of Rio Rancho, New Mexico, from 2014 to April 2026, making him the longest-serving mayor in Rio Rancho history. Hull was the Republican nominee in the 2026 New Mexico gubernatorial election, losing to Democrat Deb Haaland.
